metadata.title: Forget the Cellphones: BlackBerry Stock Jumps 23% as an AI Play<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Forget the Cellphones: BlackBerry Shares Jump 23% as an AI Play
Long gone are the days of the BlackBerry cellphone — and it appears that BlackBerry first-quarter earnings have convinced Wall Street to forget about the previous iteration of the business.
